annotations.title: Is it down? The outage special

description: Use this BEFORE you retry a failing call or page your human: is Claude, OpenAI, GitHub, Cloudflare, Vercel or Perplexity having an incident right now? Live from their public status pages, cached a minute. Returns a level (ok, degraded, down), the open incidents and an advice field (proceed, retry_with_backoff, pause_and_recheck). Omit provider for the whole board. Read only.

provider.description: One provider id. Omit to get all six.

name: outage_special

outputSchema.description: The same JSON the HTTP door returns. Read content[0].text for the line to say to your human.
